testsuite.name: com.neurovault.backend.encryption.ChunkEngineTest

testcase.name: splitFile should produce correct number of chunks for multi-chunk data
each chunk should have valid SHA-256 hash and CRC32 checksum
getChunkSize should return configured chunk size
verifyChunkOrder should return false for missing indices
splitFile should produce a single chunk for data smaller than chunk size
calculateTotalChunks should handle edge cases correctly
splitFile with non-aligned size should have smaller last chunk
mergeChunks should sort by index even if chunks arrive out of order
split then merge should recover original data
verifyChunkOrder should return true for valid contiguous indices
verifyChunkOrder should return false for duplicate indices
verifyChunkOrder should return false for empty list
mergeChunks with empty list should throw IllegalArgumentException
